writes=[(paths[0],state.encode('utf-8')),(paths[1],dec.encode('utf-8'))]

     'latest_training_tail_policy_clock_explanation':R24+'/result.json',

    optional={
     'next_research_question':next_text,'latest_completed_branch_boundary':summary,
     'latest_completed_historical_branch_boundary':summary,

    for k,v in optional.items():

    oldsummary=before.get('latest_result_summary')

    cfg.update(updates)
    for k,v in before.items():
        if k not in updates:assert cfg[k]==v,'非进度字段变化：'+k
    changes[path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()]=sorted(k for k in set(before)|set(cfg) if before.get(k)!=cfg.get(k))
    writes.append((path,(json.dumps(cfg,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n').encode('utf-8')))
for path,_ in writes:assert path.read_bytes()==snap[path],'共享文件已变，停止覆盖：'+str(path)
